title: lane r2 Meth: single-commit fix cannot produce red at its parent baseline
description: Lane round 2. Lens: vsdd-methodology (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: the fix's test lives in the fix commit; checked out at the parent the test is absent, so plain checkout-and-run runs green — the gate is unsatisfiable-as-written for the single-commit case it names, and 'exactly as at layer scale' is false (2a's test commit carries tests-without-implementation by construction; a single-commit fix collapses that separation). Citations verified: contract:64, :66. Proposed: resolved-candidate — define test application at fix scale explicitly: the gate checks out the baseline and applies the defect's test to it (Thermite's critic protocol proves the test-first shape upstream; where test and fix share a commit, gate-performed test injection is the defined mechanism).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: test application defined as the fix-scale mechanism — the gate checks out the baseline and applies the defect's named test(s) to it, since a fix and its test may share a commit; 'exactly as at layer scale' language dropped in favor of mechanized-like-the-layer-gate with topology-aware mechanism. Thermite's critic-fixer test-first protocol is the upstream proof. Revision: Phase exit by gate bullet.
